title: Coinbase One Card | Turn every purchase into bitcoin.
description:
Introducing: The Coinbase One Card. The first of its kind credit card designed to bring the power of digital currency into the physical world. Earn up to 4% back in bitcoin on every purchase, plus all of the benefits included in a Coinbase One membership. 

Terms, conditions, and limitations apply. Bitcoin-back rates are based on cardholder’s assets on Coinbase. Not all transactions are eligible purchases. Subject to eligibility and approval. Offered through Coinbase, Inc. and Cardless, Inc. Cards issued by First Electronic Bank. Learn more at coinbase.com/creditcard.

✅ Subscribe to our channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCofTOFX4QuhT8OY-3-fFRFw/?sub_confirmation=1

#coinbase #crypto #blockchain #bitcoin #creditcard 

__

This content is being provided to you for informational purposes only. Nothing discussed in this video is intended to be investment advice. This content, and any information contained therein, does not constitute a recommendation by Coinbase to buy, sell or hold any security, financial product or instrument referenced in the content.

asr.full_text: This card doesn't give you points, or lock you in a system telling you how to spend them. No. The Coinbase OneCard does something different. It gives you back something of actual value. Like the best performing asset of the last decade. Up to 4% Bitcoin back with every purchase. Turn everything you buy into Bitcoin.
